# Import Data

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import libraries
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
library(clusterCrit)
library(uwot)
library(proxy)
library(kableExtra)
library(forcats)
library(lubridate)
library(survival)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(webshot2)
library(yaml)

# Load config
config <- yaml::yaml.load_file("config/paths.yml")
pod_derived_dir <- file.path(config$paths$derived_data, "01_POD")
pod_results_benchmarking_dir <- file.path("data", "results", "clustering", "01_POD", "benchmarking")
pod_hdbscan_results_dir <- file.path("data", "results", "clustering", "01_POD", "HDBSCAN")
pod_hdbscan_cohort_dir <- file.path(config$paths$cohorts, "01_POD", "HDBSCAN_clusters")
pod_figures_dir <- file.path(config$paths$figures, "main", "01_POD")

# Import clustering results 
benchmarking_results <- read_csv(file.path(pod_results_benchmarking_dir, "pod_hdbscan_benchmark_results_hdbscan_100minPts.csv"))

medley_hdbscan_results <- read_csv(file.path(pod_hdbscan_results_dir, "pod_hdbscan_results_2pcs_centered_unscaled_100minPts.csv"))

# Import POD cohort features and medication data 
pod_study_cohort_features <- read_csv(file.path(config$paths$cohorts, "final_cohort_features.csv"))
pod_medications <- read_csv(file.path(config$paths$derived_data, "pod_medications_cleaned.csv"))

# Filter pod_medications to subjects in pod_study_cohort_features
pod_medications_filtered <- pod_medications %>% filter(subject_id %in% pod_study_cohort_features$subject_id)

# Add column for total POD medications administered to pod_study_cohort_features 
pod_med_admin <- pod_medications_filtered %>%
  count(subject_id, name = "total_pod_med_admin")

pod_study_cohort_features <- pod_study_cohort_features %>%
  left_join(pod_med_admin, by = "subject_id") %>%
  mutate(
    total_pod_med_admin = coalesce(total_pod_med_admin, 0L))

# Import medication representations
binary_representation <- read_csv(file.path(pod_derived_dir, "pod_med_binary_rep.csv"))
count_representation <- read_csv(file.path(pod_derived_dir, "pod_med_count_rep.csv"))
cumulative_dose_representation <- read_csv(file.path(pod_derived_dir, "pod_med_cumulative_dose_rep.csv"))

# Import cluster assignments
medley_cluster_assignments <- read_csv(file.path(pod_hdbscan_cohort_dir, "pod_hdbscan_cl_list_clusters_2pcs_centered_unscaled_100minPts.csv"))

binary_med_pca_cluster_assignments <- read_csv(file.path(pod_results_benchmarking_dir, "binary_med_pca2d_hdbscan_clusters_100minPts.csv"))

count_med_pca_cluster_assignments <- read_csv(file.path(pod_results_benchmarking_dir, "count_med_pca2d_hdbscan_clusters_100minPts.csv"))

cumulative_dose_med_pca_cluster_assignments <- read_csv(file.path(pod_results_benchmarking_dir, "cumulative_dose_med_pca2d_hdbscan_clusters_100minPts.csv"))

dir.create(pod_figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2D PCA visualizations

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
create_pca_plot <- function(data,
                            cluster_assignments,
                            title) {

  # PCA on representation
  pca_result <- prcomp(
    data %>% select(-subject_id, -hadm_id, -stay_id),
    center = TRUE,
    scale. = FALSE
  )

  pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])

  # Add cluster labels
  plot_df <- cbind(
    cluster_assignments %>% select(subject_id, cluster),
    pca_data
  )

  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
             color = factor(cluster))) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "PC1",
      y = "PC2",
      color = "Cluster"
    ) +
    theme_nature
}

p1 <- create_pca_plot(
  binary_representation,
  binary_med_pca_cluster_assignments,
  "Binary (PCA)"
)

p2 <- create_pca_plot(
  count_representation,
  count_med_pca_cluster_assignments,
  "Count (PCA)"
)

p3 <- create_pca_plot(
  cumulative_dose_representation,
  cumulative_dose_med_pca_cluster_assignments,
  "Cumulative Dose (PCA)"
)

library(patchwork)

p1 / p2 / p3
```

# Cluster Summary Tables

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

create_cluster_summary_kable <- function(cluster_assignments,
                                         method_name,
                                         include_noise = FALSE) {
  
  summary_df <- cluster_assignments %>%
    select(subject_id, cluster, is_noise) %>%
    left_join(pod_study_cohort_features, by = "subject_id") %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = ifelse(is_noise, "Noise", paste0("Cluster ", cluster)),
      cluster = factor(cluster),
      gender = factor(gender),
      pod_medication_use = factor(pod_medication_use)
    )
  
  if (!include_noise) {
    summary_df <- summary_df %>%
      filter(!is_noise)
  }
  
  cluster_summary <- summary_df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      `Count` = n(),
      
      `POD medication use, n (%)` = paste0(
        sum(pod_medication_use == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
        round(100 * mean(pod_medication_use == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%)"
      ),
      
      `POD med administrations, median (min, max)` = paste0(
        round(median(total_pod_med_admin, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " (",
        round(min(total_pod_med_admin, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ", ",
        round(max(total_pod_med_admin, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"
      ),
      
      `Age, mean (SD)` = paste0(
        round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " (",
        round(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"
      ),
      
      `Male, n (%)` = paste0(
        sum(gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE), " (",
        round(100 * mean(gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%)"
      ),
      
      `POD resolution days, median (IQR)` = paste0(
        round(median(pod_resolution_days, na.rm = TRUE), 1), " (",
        round(quantile(pod_resolution_days, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ", ",
        round(quantile(pod_resolution_days, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1), ")"
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  cluster_summary %>%
    kable(
      caption = paste0(method_name, " cluster characteristics"),
      align = "lcccccc",
      booktabs = TRUE
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
      full_width = FALSE,
      position = "center",
      font_size = 10
    )
}

binary_pca_summary <- create_cluster_summary_kable(
  binary_med_pca_cluster_assignments,
  method_name = "Binary representation, with PCA"
)

count_pca_summary <- create_cluster_summary_kable(
  count_med_pca_cluster_assignments,
  method_name = "Count representation, with PCA"
)

cumulative_dose_pca_summary <- create_cluster_summary_kable(
  cumulative_dose_med_pca_cluster_assignments,
  method_name = "Cumulative dose representation, with PCA"
)

binary_pca_summary
count_pca_summary
cumulative_dose_pca_summary
```

# Benchmarking Results Table 

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define colors for methods
method_colors <- c(
  "#A6CEE3",  # MEDLEY (light blue)
  "#B2DF8A",  # Binary (light green)
  "#FDBF6F",  # Counts (light orange)
  "#CAB2D6"   # Cumulative dose (light purple)
)

# Benchmarking Results Table
medley_hdbscan_cl_list <- medley_hdbscan_results %>%
  filter(method == "CL List")

medley_hdbscan_cl_list$noise_n <-
  nrow(medley_cluster_assignments %>% filter(cluster == 0))

comparison_methods <- benchmarking_results %>%
  filter(preprocessing == "PCA_2_PCs") %>%
  select(-preprocessing)

benchmarking_table_data <- rbind(
  medley_hdbscan_cl_list,
  comparison_methods
)

benchmarking_table_data <- benchmarking_table_data %>%
  select(method, num_clusters, noise_n, silhouette, chi, dbi) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = c(
      "MEDLEY",
      "Binary indicators",
      "Medication counts",
      "Cumulative dose"
    ),
    `Number of clusters` = num_clusters,
    `Noise (%)` = round(100 * noise_n / nrow(pod_study_cohort_features), 1),
    `SS ↑` = round(silhouette, 3),
    `CHI ↑` = formatC(chi, format = "e", digits = 2),
    `DBI ↓` = round(dbi, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Method, `Number of clusters`, `Noise (%)`, `SS ↑`, `CHI ↑`, `DBI ↓`)

benchmarking_table_data <- benchmarking_table_data %>%
  mutate(
    `CHI ↑` = formatC(`CHI ↑`, format = "e", digits = 2),
    `CHI ↑` = gsub("e\\+0?", "e", `CHI ↑`)
  )

# Add a column for representative phenotypes
benchmarking_table_data$`Representative phenotypes` <- c(
  "No medications; sedative-dominant care; targeted vs. multimodal therapy",
  "Medication users vs. non-users",
  "Low-, medium-, and high-frequency medication use",
  "Low- vs. high-intensity exposure"
)

# Change row ordering to place MEDLEY at the bottom
benchmarking_table_data <- benchmarking_table_data[c(2:nrow(benchmarking_table_data), 1), ]

benchmarking_clustering_results <- benchmarking_table_data %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    align = "lcccccc",
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  # Fix column widths 
  column_spec(1, width = "5cm") %>% 
  column_spec(2, width = "3cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "3cm") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(5, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(6, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(7, width = "10cm") %>%
  column_spec(
    1,
    bold = TRUE,
    background = method_colors,
    color = "black"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 14
  )

# Save table as a PNG
save_kable(
  benchmarking_clustering_results,
  file = file.path(pod_figures_dir, "pod_benchmarking_clustering_results_table_for_figure.png"),
  zoom = 2
)

benchmarking_clustering_results
```

# Methods Comparison Table

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)

check <- "\u2713"   # ✓
cross <- "\u2717"   # ✗

methods_summary <- data.frame(
  Method = c("Binary indicators",
             "Medication counts",
             "Cumulative dose",
             "MEDLEY"),
  Exposure = c(check, check, check, check),
  Frequency = c(cross, check, cross, check),
  `Dose intensity` = c(cross, cross, check, check),
  Timing = c(cross, cross, cross, check),
  `Medication sequence` = c(cross, cross, cross, check),
  check.names = FALSE
)

benchmark_methods_comparison <- methods_summary %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "lccccc"
  ) %>%
  # Fix column widths 
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm") %>% 
  column_spec(2, width = "3.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "3.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "3.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(5, width = "3.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(6, width = "4.5cm") %>%
    column_spec(
    1,
    bold = TRUE,
    background = method_colors,
    color = "black"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 14
  )

# Save table as a PNG
save_kable(
  benchmark_methods_comparison,
  file = file.path(pod_figures_dir, "pod_benchmark_methods_comparison_table_for_figure.png"),
  zoom = 2
)

benchmark_methods_comparison
```
